page.overview:
Who is Borri Silverfoot?

Borri Silverfoot, Lord of the Silver Pinnacle was the Dwarf King of Karaz Bryn.

He kept above his throne the vast skull of the Dragon he had killed.

In -326 IC he was a broad, powerfully built Dwarf, favouring a sleaveless suit of fine mail and a simple circlet of his office with silver charms in his beard.

After a huge dragon killed his father and brother, he slew the beast and turned its lair into the settlement that would become the Dwarf Hold of Karaz Bryn.
